## Attendance

## Items

No new incidents or changes were reported. The board noted that there were no additional items requiring decision or escalation during the meeting.

The current position remains subject to routine review through the programme board. Members agreed that any further issues arising before the next meeting should be brought forward through the usual process.

Actions were carried forward to the next meeting. The board will continue to monitor captures, the backlog and letter breaches, with the recorded figures providing the position for the next review.

No new actions were recorded at this meeting. Progress against carried-forward actions, together with any changes to the performance position, will be considered at the next meeting.
